Hi Ben —

Quick ask: Helios Health (healthtech, mid-market payer) is interested in a pilot for patient-sentiment summaries and secure embeddings. We think there’s a healthy co-sell here and would like an AWS warm intro to the Helios contacts so we can run a joint account planning / kickoff next week.

Attaching a short mutual-action-plan draft (Helios_MAP_v1.pdf) and our intake template to speed the process. Can you make a quick intro to the Helios stakeholder who owns data/analytics? If you can also flag any preferred AWS SEs or procurement touchpoints, that’d be great.

Internal owners: Vivek — lead commercial; Karthik — procurement + procurement timeline; Laura — technical lead for initial scoping.

Ideal agenda for a 45-minute kickoff:
- 10m intros + objectives
- 15m current architecture & data constraints (Laura)
- 10m proposal & deployment options (Redwood + AWS)
